Payload Description: The payload “Camera SpaceMast System” shall be flown in a hosted configuration and can be considered roughly as a block volume with rectangular dimensions. The mast and therefore the camera box can be retracted and re-deployed multiple times. Actuation of deployment and retraction is driven by an electrical motor and controlled by the Electronics Compartment. A principal aim of the technical development is to create computer-based encodings of this Insular repertoire of compositions from c.1150 to c.1350, including information about both the musical content and the characteristics of the medieval notation in which the music was originally recorded.
